message: Add a time-to-live to cache entries

findings.summary: Eviction pops the oldest key from `_order` and runs `del self._data[oldest]`, which raises KeyError when `get` has already dropped that expired key from `_data`.
`get` drops an expired key from `_data` and `_expires` but leaves it in `_order`, so a later eviction of that key raises KeyError.
The ttl is documented in milliseconds, but it is added to `time.monotonic()`, which counts seconds.
